description: Filter whose focus frequency sweeps cyclically over a range. Pinned to submode 2 (BAND-PASS) — most musically useful sweep behavior for textured source material. 'filter sweeping' has four filter-shape sub-modes (notch, bandpass, lowpass, highpass); other shapes can be added as separate curated entries later.
musical_use: Time-varying bandpass that sweeps between lofrq and hifrq at sweepfrq Hz. Classic wah/sweep effects, automatic spectral animation, vowel-formant-like motion. The 'phase' parameter controls where in the sweep cycle playback starts, useful for stylistic choices (rising vs falling at the entry).

acuity.description: Filter acuity. Smaller values give a tighter (narrower) filter. Rule of thumb from CDP docs: if acuity = (1/3)^n, gain = (2/3)^n.

gain.description: Overall gain on output. See the acuity rule-of-thumb above.

sweepfrq.description: Frequency of the sweep itself. To sweep once over the range, set sweepfrq = infiledur/2 and phase = 0 (up) or 0.5 (down).

tail.description: Decay tail duration appended after the input ends.

phase.description: Start of sweep: 0 = lofrq rising, 0.5 = hifrq falling, 1 = lofrq. Default 0.25 = midfrq rising.

examples.description: Bandpass sweep between 200 Hz and 4 kHz at 1 Hz, starting mid-range and rising.
examples.expected_use: Animate a sustained or looped texture with a slow, audible spectral sweep.
